answer.rationale: memory_c2 confirms the low-cost vendor's invoicing has been accurate and onboarding was quick, which is the specific risk under switching at high utilization. The mandate is met by their quote alone, the contract does not auto-renew, and c2 directly speaks to the operational viability of this vendor on this commodity. Other memories (c1, c4, c6) describe benefits of the incumbent path that do not offset the 18% mandate, and c3 (second-source) is structural insurance, not a unit-cost lever against a mandate. Renewal with the incumbent (c1/c4/c6) would not meet the finance mandate. Deferral (c5) leaves the mandate unmet. One switch at the contracted boundary, with a guarded ramp, is the only action that hits the cost target while staying inside the 14-day window and the 94% utilization constraint.
